title: Dopemux Embedded Audit + PR Cleanup Reconciled TP Series
description: Delta reconciliation of embedded audit and PR cleanup infrastructure. Not greenfield architecture — docs/ops/operating-model.md and docs/ops/tool-routing-matrix.md already exist. This series hardens CI triggers, evidence bundling, PR Steward freshness, auditor routing, PAL clink runner, Action Bridge, Copilot scaffold, PR gate, branch policy audit, Steward hardening, fixtures, and proof normalization.
authority: Reconciled synthesis from GPT-5.5 Pro + Opus audit (May 27, 2026). Runtime repo truth outranks this document. Verify paths before edit.
load_mechanism_evidence: Repo has task-packets/ directory with JSON/MD packets following dopetask-canonical-spec.json. MCP task-orchestrator tools available but live load not explicitly authorized by operator for this session.
forbidden_surfaces: gh pr merge / approve / ready / comment
Codex as formal auditor (schema excludes it)
red_lane_supervisor_items: tools/pr_merge reuse in PR Steward/Action Bridge
